Read-only navigational encyclopedia and production index for S7NS. Not canon and never a replacement for the project's authoritative source hierarchy.
## Current orientation
- Branch: S3_RESET_CAMPFIRE_CANON_CHRIS_RETOLD_20261017
- Delivered: Season 3 Episode 20, The Express Service. Delivery is not automatic acceptance.
- Next: Episode 21, unwritten until authorized PLAY.
- Current solo focus: Kaze and Briar, first meeting pending under author override.
## Where truth lives
- MANIFEST.yaml and authority/Resolution_Register.json control file routing and conflict resolution.
- authority/Character_Removal_20261018.json controls identity exclusion.
- state/Post_Chris_Restart.json and newest matching-branch episode evidence control the cursor.
- `canon/presentation/Season3_Scene_Decision_Doctrine_20261010.md` is the sole story construction procedure.
- Complete mechanics, voice, psychology and relationship owners remain mandatory when relevant.
## Production integrations
Airtable reference base: S7NS Continuity Control (Reference), now 772 readback-verified records including 453 source-owner routes. Existing Drive production folders now contain the original verified source snapshot and available exact E19/E20 manuscript/checkpoint pairs. All seven encyclopedia sections are populated in place. GitHub is now connected: private `kazekamimp3/kaze808`, selected-repository App scope, 44 exact imported files and a successful remote source-integrity run. The verified import is commit `a8796b3bd4c5c2b94c893b55db9dcc79fca5b703`; checkpoint branch `checkpoint/s7ns-verified-import-20261018` preserves it. AI Voice Generator is excluded by author direction; no active narration provider is selected. Research and visual production retain source/approval gates.
## Populated sections
Characters, mechanics and restrictions, episode archive, consequences, author decisions, research and evidence, approved visuals, and audio playback. Populated as derived source directories; full source owners remain mandatory. Historical current labels cannot override newer scoped author instructions.
## Change control
Proposed change -\> authorized owner + routes updated -\> manifest hashes updated -\> validation -\> confirmed installation readback -\> only authorized PLAY -\> provisional delivery -\> author acceptance separately.
